description: Calculate trucking diesel fuel surcharge (FSC) per mile and total load fuel cost using the formula (Diesel Price − Base Fuel Peg) ÷ Truck MPG. Automatically fetches FreightFA's latest U.S. EIA weekly retail on-highway diesel price when diesel_price_per_gal is null. Optionally combines with a base linehaul $/mile to return all-in $/mile and total load cost. Does not count toward the estimate allowance.

base_peg_per_gal.description: Contract base fuel peg in $/gallon (commonly 1.25 or 1.20). Null defaults to 1.25.

diesel_price_per_gal.description: Retail diesel price in $/gallon. Pass null to use FreightFA's latest weekly U.S. EIA on-highway diesel reading.

equipment.description: Equipment type for default MPG (dry_van=6.0, reefer=5.5, flatbed=5.0). Null defaults to 'dry_van'.

linehaul_per_mile.description: Optional base linehaul rate in $/mile to calculate all-in $/mile and total load cost.

miles.description: Loaded highway miles (e.g. 925), or null for per-mile FSC only.

mpg.description: Override truck fuel economy in MPG (e.g. 6.0, 5.5, 6.5). Null uses the equipment preset.

name: calculate_fuel_surcharge
title: Calculate trucking diesel fuel surcharge (FSC)
